hooks.name: Format and lint on save
hooks.description: After the agent saves or edits a Python file, auto-format it and apply safe lint fixes with ruff, so the steering conventions (line length, import order, modern syntax) are enforced without a manual step.

action.command: ruff format yoyo_tracker tests && ruff check --fix yoyo_tracker tests

hooks.name: Require tests for new core modules
hooks.description: When the agent creates a new module under the pure core layer, inject a reminder to add matching tests, upholding the steering rule that core logic is always covered.

action.prompt: A new module was created under yoyo_tracker/core/. Per the project steering conventions, core logic must have test coverage. Add or extend a matching tests/test_<module>.py with unit tests (and property tests where an invariant applies), then run ruff and the touched tests before continuing.
